meta.comment: PHASE 2 starter upgrade catalog (ROADMAP Upgrades (basic purchasable boosts)). Each upgrade is data-driven: a player spends resources to buy levels, and each level contributes an effect. Category='qiRateAdd' upgrades write their aggregate into cultivation.qiSources.upgrades, which QiSystem reads through config.qi.sources — no code change to QiSystem was needed. Cost formula: cost(N+1) = floor(baseCost * costGrowth^N), so baseCost is the level-1 price and costGrowth controls the per-level curve. maxLevel is null for unlimited; an integer caps the upgrade. Adding/removing an upgrade requires only editing this file plus a matching costResource id in config.resources.items (validation rejects drift between the two).

definitions.name: Foundation Breathing
definitions.description: +1 qi/s per level. A simple breath technique that strengthens the foundation of your cultivation.

definitions.name: Qi Gathering
definitions.description: +5 qi/s per level. Refines the technique of gathering ambient qi into your dantian.

definitions.name: Meridian Cleansing
definitions.description: +50 qi/s per level. Slowly purges the meridians of blockages that hinder qi flow.

definitions.name: Spirit Root Enhancement
definitions.description: +500 qi/s per level. A measured ritual that sharpens the cultivator's spiritual roots.
